text: This major focuses on the core objective of "harmonious coexistence between humans and nature", conducting research on the composition and evolution patterns of the environment (including atmosphere, water, soil, ecosystems, etc.), as well as the impact of human activities on the environment. At the same time, it explores engineering technologies and management strategies for pollution control, ecological restoration, and resource recycling. The core task is to address global issues such as environmental pollution, ecological damage, and climate change, and to promote sustainable development of the social economy.
